Docusaurus-style Article

This paragraph lives inside the container div a real Docusaurus theme renders its article in, carrying the "markdown" class among others. DocusaurusParser extracts only this subtree, discarding the surrounding navigation, header, and footer chrome.

A second paragraph, so the extracted article has more than one block of text to carry forward into whatever parses it.
